title: Outreach organization
description: One organization, office or Native nation the project may ask for help (co-authoring, review, consultation, art). Holds only public facts: who it is, why it matters to the project, and its public institutional contact path, each with a source. Named people, suggested asks, priority and contact history are kept privately (decision record 0012). Stored as research/outreach/<id>.yaml and never published on the website.

id.description: Equals the file name. Spelled out, no acronyms (native-american-rights-fund, not narf).

name.description: Name as the organization writes it.

also_known_as.description: Acronyms, former names and other names in use.

part_of.description: Id of another outreach record this one belongs to (a program of a fund, a center of a school).

tribe_profile.description: For a Native nation: id of its profile in content/tribes/, which holds the nation's office contacts. Contacts are not repeated here.

scope.description: Who the organization serves: the whole country, several states, one state, or one community or campus.

text.description: What the organization does that matters to the project, stated as facts its sources support.

possible_roles.description: Kinds of help the organization could plausibly give, judged by the project from its relevance (project analysis).

contacts.description: Public, institutional contact paths only, as the organization publishes them: a contact form, a general office inbox, a main telephone line, a mailing address, or a web page. Never a person's direct email, telephone or address. Empty for a Native nation, whose contacts are in its Tribe profile.

label.description: Which office the contact reaches, e.g. 'General office'.

sources.description: Sources for this record. Outreach records cite web pages inline rather than through content/sources/, because they are project planning data and not part of the reader-facing bibliography.

verification.description: page-read: the page itself was read. search-result-only: only a search result snippet was seen; confirm before relying on it.

supports.description: What this source supports in the record.

checked.description: Date the record was last checked against its sources.

notes.description: Renames, uncertainties and cautions. Never names a person.

notes_sources.description: Ids from this record's sources list that support the notes.

sourceIds.description: Ids from this record's sources list.
